info.title: Lumen local API
info.description: View models for Lumen's desktop UI and browser dashboard (ADR-0011).

AiKeySourceView.description: Where the judge's key comes from (ADR-0042); never the key itself.

AiKeyView.description: Which service the judge's key is for; never the key itself.

AiNoteView.description:
An AI note on a review item: only a closed kind and a confidence, never
model text.

kind.description: What the item most likely is.

AiSettingsView.description:
Whether AI review is on (ADR-0037), whether the user has chosen yet
(ADR-0050), and which key it would use.

chosen.description:
Whether the user has chosen on or off. Until they have, AI review is
off and the app asks once (ADR-0050).

consented_at.description: When the user last turned it on; `null` if never.

enabled.description: Whether assessments ask the judge about proposed quarantines.

key.description: Which service the key it would use is for; `none` without a key.

oneOf.description: Where that key comes from; `null` without a key.

AppDataKindView.description: What kind of location the platform documents an app data folder as.

AssessProgressView.description: Advisory progress, without paths or contents. Never an action input.

completed.description: Units processed, as a decimal string.

stage.description: Work currently running; percentages are local to this stage.

total.description: Total units for this stage; null when unknown.

AssessStageView.description: Current assessment work. Each stage has its own units and total.

oneOf.description: Directly observed.

Concluded from not finding something in these sources, each of which
was searched completely.

What AI review says a review item most likely is (ADR-0041): a note
for people, labelled as AI, that never changes the verdict. `null`
unless the item is under review and AI review described it.

facts.description:
The facts the decision saw about it, and whether each application
that owns it is installed (ADR-0053). For in use, owned by the
current user and owner installed, a missing fact means the question
could not be answered: unknown, never "no".

oneOf.description:
For an item kept only because running apps use it: the policy would
propose it once they are closed and it is scanned again. Display only:
the verdict stays `keep` and nothing plans from it. `null` otherwise.

group.description: The group it is presented in.

id.description:
Its opaque ID, from its file identity, never its path (ADR-0053):
stable within an assessment and across scans while the platform
reports the same volume and file IDs, and shared by hard links to it.
For matching relations; rows stay keyed by `path`.

reasons.description: Why: one reason per policy rule that fired, in the policy's order.

rechecks.description:
What Lumen did not know when it decided, which "Check again" would ask
(ADR-0058); empty when the verdict rests on decisions only. Optional
on input for compatibility with older hosts.

reclaimable_bytes.description: What removing it would free now, in bytes.

reclaimable_exact.description:
Whether `reclaimable_bytes` is exact rather than a lower bound (a
listing could not rule out shared blocks, ADR-0017).

relations.description:
The relationships in its decision's evidence bundle, nearest first
and bounded (ADR-0053).

oneOf.description:
Versioned descriptive review categories, never permission to change a
verdict. Optional on input for compatibility with older hosts.

times.description:
Its modification and access times as the decision saw them, each
saying how far it can be relied on (ADR-0053).

oneOf.description:
The cleanup command of the developer tool that owns it, if the tool
has one: displayed in full and run by entry ID after desktop confirmation.

ChooserView.description: Who put an item into a plan (ADR-0051).

oneOf.description: The person closed the dialog; nothing was read.
This platform cannot read contents to compare yet.
The folders hold more files than one comparison covers.

limit.description: The most files one comparison covers.

oneOf.description:
The person stopped the comparison; no groups are shown, since a stopped
comparison proves nothing about the files it did not finish.
The comparison finished.

CompareProgressView.description: A running comparison's step and how many files it has read.

DiskView.description: How full the disk holding the user's home folder is.

available_bytes.description: The bytes the user may still write, in bytes.

DuplicateGroupView.description: Files with the same contents, for a person to review.

bytes_each.description: The size of each copy, in bytes.

DuplicatesView.description: What a comparison found and what it could not cover.

groups.description:
Identical copies, the largest extra copies first. Copies can share
blocks (APFS clones), so this is not space removing one would free.

hard_links.description: Names of one file (hard links): not copies, and removing one frees nothing.

incomplete.description: Some folders could not be listed completely; files there were not compared.

protected.description: Files left unread in protected locations.

skipped.description: Files not compared: changed, unreadable, cloud-only or protected by the system.

ExecuteRequest.description:
A request to execute a plan: its ID and, as the confirmation, its full
hash.

confirmation.description: The plan's full hash, as shown.

oneOf.description: It belongs to this application.
Whether an application that owns it is installed.
It is an application data location of a documented kind.
It matches a developer knowledge-base entry.
A vendor declared it a disposable cache.
The operating system's protection flags on it.

system_restricted.description: System Integrity Protection or an equivalent.

oneOf.description:
Whether it is synced with a cloud service, or holds or lies in synced
content.
It holds a web browser profile's state.

marker.description: The entry that showed it, relative to the item.

oneOf.description: A large folder no other evidence names; says nothing about what it is.

reclaimable_bytes.description: What removing it would free, as the scan measured it, in bytes.

oneOf.description: Whether a running process uses it, every process checked.

No process Lumen could see uses it, but not every process was
visible: not proof of non-use.

unseen.description:
How many processes could not be checked, as a decimal string;
`null` when the platform did not say.

oneOf.description: Whether the account Lumen runs as owns it.

Whether an application that owns it is running (ADR-0059). `false`
only when every process was visible.

When the platform last recorded an application that owns it being
opened (ADR-0059). Shown, never decided on: an old date is not proof
the application is unused.

When the project it belongs to last changed: the newest modification
time of the project's marker files (ADR-0059). Shown, never decided on.

FactKindView.description: One fact, typed. Untrusted text is escaped for display.

FactView.description: One fact the decision saw, with where it came from.

source.description: The adapter that produced it, such as `macos.support-location.bundle-id`.

FinalizeOutcomeView.description: What a finalization did to one held item.

original.description: Where the item was, if known.

oneOf.description: Observed volume change; unavailable readings are never zero.
Removed for good.
Back at its original place already; nothing removed.
Not in the store; nothing removed.
The removal stopped part way.
It may be in use, or that cannot be checked; nothing removed.
Not retained; nothing done.

FreeWhenClosedView.description: The apps to close so that a kept item could be proposed on the next scan.

processes.description:
What the probe reported using it, as escaped display names (such as
`Spotify`), sorted; empty when the platform did not name them.

GroupKindView.description: The kind of group an item is presented in.

GroupView.description: The group an item is presented in, and what it belongs to when known.

source.description:
The developer tool (e.g. `Xcode`) or the owning application's
identifier, as untrusted display text; `null` when unknown.

oneOf.description:
Who chose it (ADR-0051); `null` if that was not recorded. Only an item
the policy proposed is removed for good when its retention ends; the
others stay until the person restores or removes them.

reclaim_bytes.description:
What removing it for good would free, in bytes, as the confirmed plan
estimated; `null` for items quarantined before sizes were recorded.

oneOf.description: Not asked: it is not enabled.
It answered.

current.description: It matches this app; otherwise turn it off and on again.

oneOf.description:
This build is not signed with a Developer ID, so it cannot use the
helper.
It did not answer.
It is not signed by the same team as this app.
It refused the request.
Its answer could not be read.

HelperReachView.description: What asking the helper for its status gave.

HelperView.description: Lumen's helper as it stands now.

ItemKindView.description: What kind of item AI review says a review item most likely is.

ItemReportView.description: One planned item and what became of it.

reclaimable_bytes.description: What it would free, as planned, in bytes.

oneOf.description: Not moved; it is `REVIEW` at most now.
Moved into quarantine, restorable.

operation.description: The operation, for restoring or finalizing it.

oneOf.description: The move failed.

ItemResultView.description: What became of one planned item.

LinkedServiceView.description: A background item linked to a piece of software.

ambiguous.description: It matched other software too: this is one candidate, not the owner.

label.description: Its label, service name or entry name; display-escaped.

verified.description: The link is proven: its program lies inside this software and no other.

LocationView.description: Where an item is after a failure.

oneOf.description:
A filesystem object: this candidate, another candidate with the same
`id`, or one Lumen did not assess (then no path is known here).
An installed or once-installed application.
A running process.

pid.description: Its process ID, as a decimal string.

oneOf.description: A background, startup or scheduled component.
A volume.

NodeView.description: One end of a relationship. Untrusted text is escaped for display.

NotRestoredView.description: Why a restore did not happen.

PlanView.description: A cleanup plan, waiting for confirmation.

created_at.description: When it was made; it expires 24 hours later.

hash.description: Its full hash: the confirmation the user gives to execute it.

items.description: Its items, each with what it would free and why.

moved_bytes.description: What the quarantined items will free once finalized, in bytes.

resolved.description: Interrupted operations from earlier runs that were resolved first.

warnings.description: Problems that did not stop the execution.

QuitView.description:
What asking a running app to quit did. It was asked the way its Quit menu
item asks, so it may ask to save or decline; preview it again to see
whether it still runs.

ReasonView.description: One policy rule that fired, and its fixed sentence (ADR-0014).

rule.description:
The rule's stable identifier, such as `classify.devkb-regenerable`, so
an interface can show the reason in the user's language.

ReassessGapView.description: Something the earlier assessment did not know.

oneOf.description: Its verdict does not rest on anything unknown; nothing was checked.
It changed since the scan, so it was not decided again: scan again.
Decided again from fresh evidence.

added_facts.description: How many facts the checks added.

ReassessOutcomeView.description: How checking one item again ended.

ids.description:
Items of the latest assessment, by [`CandidateView::id`]. Empty: every
item kept or reviewed because of something Lumen did not know.

cancelled.description: The run stopped early; later items were not checked.

items.description: Every item checked before the run ended.

id.description: Its ID, as in the assessment.

RelationKindView.description: The kind of a relationship, read `from <kind> to`.

RelationView.description: One relationship in the candidate's evidence bundle.

hops.description: 1 when it touches the candidate, 2 when it is one step further.

edges.description:
At most 16, the nearest first, in a fixed order. Empty means none was
recorded, not that it is unrelated to anything.

omitted.description:
How many more there are, as a decimal string: left out by the bound,
or of a kind this view does not know.

RemovalImpactView.description:
What AI review says removing a piece of software could affect besides
itself (ADR-0061): a description, never a statement that removal is safe.

RemovedView.description: How much a failed removal took.

RestoreOutcomeView.description: What a restore did to one held item.

original.description: Where the item was, if known.

oneOf.description: Back at its original place.

parent_replaced.description: Its folder had been recreated since.

verified.description:
It matched its record in full after the move; false if it changed
while in quarantine (a folder that gained or lost entries) or the
check after the move failed.

oneOf.description: Still in quarantine.
Not in a state that can be restored; nothing was done.

ReviewReasonsView.description:
Machine-readable uncertainty; unknown future codes remain displayable through
the decision's localized fired-rule explanations and supporting facts.

codes.description: Stable `snake_case` categories. Strings preserve forward compatibility.

RootView.description: What a scan found below one root.

coverage_complete.description:
Whether everything below it could be read. If not, every size here is
a lower bound.

failed.description: Entries that could not be read for other reasons.

reclaimable_bytes.description: What removing everything below it would free now, in bytes.

reclaimable_exact.description: Whether `reclaimable_bytes` is exact rather than a lower bound.

ScanProgressView.description: A running scan's totals so far, sent a few times a second while it runs.

allocated_bytes.description: Disk space the files seen so far take up, in bytes.

current.description: The folder listed most recently, if any.

unreadable.description: Folders that could not be read so far.

ScanRequest.description: A request to scan the given roots, read-only.

roots.description:
The folders to scan, as the user chose them. Empty means the whole
startup disk (`lumen_app::roots::whole_disk`).

out_of_space.description:
Whether it stopped because the disk holding the database was nearly
full; then `partial` is true too.

partial.description: Whether the scan stopped early (cancelled), so results are partial.

ServiceLinkMethodView.description: The evidence linking a background item to a piece of software.

ServiceScopeView.description: Whether a background item runs for one user or for the whole system.

SkipView.description: Why a planned item was not moved.

oneOf.description: What AI review said about it, when it may be shown (ADR-0061).

explicit.description:
Whether it was installed on request rather than as another package's
dependency; `None` where the record does not say.

hidden.description: The platform's own list hides it (Windows `SystemComponent`).

key.description: A key unique in the list: the origin and the native identifier.

location.description: Where it is installed, if recorded; display-escaped.

name.description: Its display name, if the record has one; display-escaped.

protected.description:
Part of the operating system or marked by its platform as not
removable: never removable from Lumen (ADR-0060).

services.description: Background items linked to it, verified first.

vendor.description: Its publisher or vendor, as recorded; display-escaped.

SoftwareNoteView.description:
An AI note on a piece of software: closed choices and a confidence, never
model text. Display only (ADR-0061).

purpose.description: What it is most likely for.

removal_impact.description: What removing it could most likely affect.

SoftwareOriginView.description: Which inventory recorded a piece of software, and so how it is identified.

SoftwarePurposeView.description: What AI review says a piece of software is mainly for (ADR-0061).

SoftwareSourceStateView.description: How completely one inventory was read.

SoftwareSourceView.description: One inventory and how completely it was read.

count.description: How many rows, or background items, it gave.

items.description: Every application and package, by name.

sources.description: Every inventory read, with how completely.

SpaceChangeView.description: Observed free space on one volume, not a causal cleanup guarantee.

after_available_bytes.description: Available bytes immediately afterwards; may be smaller.

volume.description: Opaque volume identity; never a path to act on.

oneOf.description: The platform reported it.

The platform reported it, but it may skip or defer updating it
(`relatime`, `noatime`, NTFS), so the real time may be later. Never
proof that the item is unused.

The item's metadata was read, but the platform kept no value: none,
or one at or before the Unix epoch, which filesystems report when
they keep none.
The item's metadata was not read, so the time is unknown.

TimeView.description: One of an item's times, and how far it can be relied on.

accessed.description: When it was last read: `may_lag`, `not_recorded` or `not_read`.

folder.description:
The times are a folder entry's own: they change when entries are
added, removed or renamed in it, never when a file inside changes, so
they do not say when its contents were last used.

modified.description:
When its content last changed: `recorded`, `not_recorded` or
`not_read`.

ToolCommandView.description:
A developer tool's own cleanup command, as a literal argument vector:
shown in full, with desktop execution by entry ID after confirmation.

args.description: Its arguments, one per element, unquoted.

entry.description:
The knowledge-base entry it comes from: the name to run it by
(ADR-0049); the page never sends the command itself.

removes_data.description:
It removes data, not just caches (Docker), so the confirmation says
what it removes.

tool.description: The tool's display name, such as `Xcode`.

ToolKindView.description: A developer tool whose own storage report the desktop shows (#705, #706, #712).

ToolRunView.description: How running a tool's command ended (ADR-0049).

exit_code.description: Its exit code, if it exited on its own.

output.description: The end of what it printed.

space_changes.description: Every matched volume measured once, or unknown measurement coverage.

timed_out.description: It ran past the time limit and was stopped.

oneOf.description: The tool answered completely.
The program is not installed where the user's terminal would find it.
This platform has no such tool or adapter.
The tool could not answer completely.

reason.description: Why, in the core's words, for display.

ToolStateView.description: Whether the tool answered. Anything but `found` means unknown, never empty.

ToolStorageItemView.description: One thing a tool reports, in the tool's own words and units.

bytes.description: An exact size in bytes, when the tool gives one.

detail.description: The tool's state or counts for it, if any.

name.description: What it is: a runtime, a Docker category, or a location.

reported_reclaimable.description: What the tool itself estimates it could free; not a Lumen promise.

reported_size.description: A size as the tool wrote it (Docker), when it gives no byte count.

ToolStorageView.description:
What one developer tool reports about its storage. Read only on request;
nothing here removes anything.

command.description:
The tool's own cleanup command, literally; it runs only through the
confirmed flow (ADR-0049).

scope.description: Which installation or daemon answered (Docker's context and endpoint).

shared_store.description: The location is a store projects link into (pnpm), not a cache.

version.description: Its version, as it prints it.

UninstallAppView.description: The application a preview is about, as observed now.

key.description: The software list's key, as given.

name.description: Its display name, if it has one; display-escaped.

notes.description: What happens to it and its data.

path.description: Where it is, for showing only; display-escaped.

size_bytes.description: What removing it for good would free, in bytes.

size_complete.description:
Every folder inside it was listed; otherwise the size is a lower
bound.

UninstallNoteView.description: What happens to the app and its data when it is uninstalled this way.

path.description: Where the app was, for showing only; display-escaped.

resolved.description: Interrupted operations from earlier runs that were resolved first.

size_bytes.description: What removing it for good frees, as previewed, in bytes.

warnings.description: Problems that did not stop it.

oneOf.description: It may be uninstalled: confirm `hash` to move it into Quarantine.

created_at.description: When it was made; it expires 24 hours later.

oneOf.description: It cannot be uninstalled this way; nothing was stored.
No installed application has that key now: list the software again.

More than one application has that key, so which one is meant is
unknown: uninstall it in Finder.
Uninstalling into quarantine is only for macOS applications.

UninstallPreviewView.description: What uninstalling an application into quarantine would do.

UninstallReasonView.description:
Why an application cannot be uninstalled into quarantine. Each `*_unknown`
reason is a check Lumen could not answer, which never counts as passing.

oneOf.description: It is in Quarantine, restorable.

operation.description: The operation, for restoring or removing it for good.

oneOf.description:
Checked again right before the move, it may not go now; it was not
moved.
It is not what the preview showed; it was not moved. Preview again.
The move failed.

UpdateView.description: The app's version and whether a newer one is published (ADR-0048).

available.description: The newer version on offer, if any.

installable.description:
Whether the app can install it itself; `false` where it cannot
replace its own files (a `.deb` install), which updates through the
download page instead.
